headlines.title_en: Wallstreetcn Breakfast | September 10, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Oil breaks above $100, combined with the eve of inflation data, US stocks fall for a third straight day, Meta bucks the trend with a 6% surge, US Treasuries decline across the board. A much-anticipated blockbuster move falls flat as the US Treasury Secretary triples the size of long-bond buybacks, with $6 billion only reaching the low end of expectations; the 10-year US Treasury yield rises above 4.84%, hitting a new high since November 2023. Trump says the Iran war will end "immediately" after the US midterms. Iran announces the establishment of a new maritime "sanctions zone" and attacks a US military base; US forces strike Iranian oil tankers; escalating Middle East tensions push Brent crude above $100 for the first time in over a month, closing at $101.21. China's Ministry of Commerce: the US allegation of AI distillation is an exercise of technological hegemony and computing-power monopoly, which China firmly opposes. China's August CPI year-on-year rise widens to 0.8%, PPI up 3.8% year-on-year, both turning positive month-on-month, driven by international oil prices and seasonal food price increases.

headlines.title: 定向可转债市场化改革提速，在房地产行业应用场景有望进一步丰富
headlines.summary: 中国证监会8月底发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，支持上市房企通过向特定对象发行方式再融资，并支持上市房企综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产。从已发行案例看，定向可转债在并购重组中主要扮演兼具债底保护与股性弹性的创新支付工具角色。业内人士认为，在房地产领域，定向可转债此前主要承担项目融资功能，未来随着行业并购需求上升，其在房地产行业中的应用场景有望进一步丰富。业内人士表示，今年已披露预案的定向可转债已达12只，远高于去年同期，具备发行扩容的基础。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Market-oriented reform of targeted convertible bonds accelerates, application scenarios in the real estate sector are expected to be further enriched
headlines.summary_en: At the end of August, the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) issued the "Opinions on Supporting the Construction of a New Model for Real Estate Development in the Capital Market," supporting listed real estate companies to refinance through targeted issuance to specific investors, and supporting listed real estate companies to comprehensively use tools such as shares, targeted convertible bonds and cash to acquire real-estate-related assets. Based on issued cases, targeted convertible bonds mainly play the role of an innovative payment tool combining debt-floor protection and equity-like flexibility in M&A and restructuring. Industry insiders believe that in the real estate sector, targeted convertible bonds previously mainly served a project financing function, and in the future, as industry M&A demand rises, their application scenarios in the real estate industry are expected to be further enriched. Industry insiders say that 12 targeted convertible bonds have already disclosed preliminary plans this year, far exceeding the same period last year, providing a foundation for issuance expansion. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: Economic Daily Jin Guanping: Injecting capital into financial central SOEs solidifies the foundation and benefits the long term
headlines.summary_en: Economic Daily's Jin Guanping published an article stating that as the lifeblood of the national economy, finance is an important component of a country's core competitiveness. Issuing special government bonds to support relevant central financial enterprises in replenishing capital is a forward-looking arrangement to prepare for bad times and a long-term move to strengthen the foundation, and is of great significance for building a financial powerhouse and helping the macroeconomy run smoothly. In 2025, the Ministry of Finance issued 500 billion yuan of special government bonds to support Bank of China, China Construction Bank, Bank of Communications and Postal Savings Bank of China in replenishing core tier-1 capital. The core tier-1 capital adequacy ratios of the four banks rose by about 0.5 to 1.4 percentage points, significantly enhancing their prudent operating capacity, credit lending capacity and risk resistance, fully demonstrating the effect of the capital injection. Another capital injection this year reflects the state's continued strong support for central financial enterprises to serve as the main force in serving the real economy and the ballast stone for maintaining financial stability. headlines.title_en: 【A-share Thermometer】The stock-bond cost-performance indicator remains at a level above one-year high
headlines.summary_en:
On September 9, the Buffett Indicator (CSI 300 market capitalization/GDP) rebounded to 92.67%, having recently remained in a state of narrow fluctuation. The stock-bond cost-effectiveness indicator—the CSI 300 Index equity risk premium (ERP)—stood at 5.67%, remaining near its high point of August 15, 2025; from a major-cycle perspective, the indicator has gradually moved from the lower end of its past five-year fluctuation range toward the middle, suggesting that the advantage of stocks relative to government bond yields has risen somewhat and returned to a neutral level.
--------
Note: 1. The Buffett Indicator compares total stock market capitalization with GDP to judge whether the stock market is currently overvalued; normally 70-100% is a reasonable valuation, below that range is undervalued, and above that range is overvalued.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Securities News front-page article: The 'certainty' of Chinese assets strengthens the inherent stability of the capital market
headlines.summary_en: Recently, discussion of "liquidity" in the market has heated up somewhat. From a global market perspective, surging government bond yields in many countries, represented by US Treasuries, have triggered widespread concerns about a liquidity squeeze; from an A-share market perspective, trading volume has shrunk somewhat in the past two days, which some voices have interpreted as a signal of tightening market liquidity. Several market experts said in interviews that current A-share liquidity remains in a healthy range, and that in the long run, China's economic and policy stability, the acceleration of technological innovation leading changes in the industrial landscape, and global market recognition of the safety of Chinese assets will all help further solidify A-shares' independent pricing capability.

headlines.title_en: The pace of listing in Hong Kong and returning to A-shares accelerates, two-way traffic is expected to continue
headlines.summary_en: Since the start of this year, the two-way flow between A-shares and Hong Kong stocks has become increasingly frequent. On one hand, A-share leaders in hard technology and consumer manufacturing have concentrated on listing H-shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, becoming one of the important sources of supply in the Hong Kong IPO market; on the other hand, Hong Kong-listed science and technology innovation companies in AI, robotics, innovative drugs and other fields are accelerating their applications to return to A-shares, with institutional advantages opening a return path for unprofitable enterprises. Nankai University finance professor Tian Lihui said that as "A+H" continues to expand, this two-way flow breaks market segmentation, promotes deep alignment of regulatory rules and information disclosure standards, and the two-way transmission of pricing power helps narrow cross-border valuation differences and improves the overall pricing efficiency of Chinese assets. This not only raises the weight of Chinese assets in global allocation, but also provides an important practical sample for building a regulated, transparent, open, dynamic and resilient modern capital market system with Chinese characteristics. headlines.title: 券商秋季策略会展望：A股“金秋行情”有望延续，扩散和均衡主导配置
headlines.summary: 金秋九月，2026年券商秋季策略会密集召开。截至9月9日，华福证券、西部证券、财通证券、天风证券等多家券商已召开秋季策略会。梳理发现，在外围市场不确定性延续的背景下，券商普遍对国内资本市场后市表现持积极态度。同时，券商投研重心已由上半年的科技“一枝独秀”明显转向“多元均衡”配置，大消费、地产链等板块的关注度显著回升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Brokerage autumn strategy meetings outlook: A-share 'golden autumn rally' is expected to continue, with diffusion and balance dominating allocation
headlines.summary_en: In golden September, the 2026 autumn strategy meetings of securities firms are being held intensively. As of September 9, a number of securities firms including Huafu Securities, Western Securities, Caitong Securities and Tianfeng Securities have held autumn strategy meetings. A review found that, against the backdrop of continued uncertainty in external markets, securities firms are generally positive about the future performance of the domestic capital market. At the same time, the focus of securities firms' investment research has clearly shifted from the "one standout" technology sector in the first half to "diversified and balanced" allocation, with attention to sectors such as major consumption and the real estate chain rising significantly. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 上海证券报头版：中国资产“确定性”筑牢资本市场内在稳定性
headlines.summary: 中国证监会8月底发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，支持上市房企通过向特定对象发行方式再融资，并支持上市房企综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产。从已发行案例看，定向可转债在并购重组中主要扮演兼具债底保护与股性弹性的创新支付工具角色。业内人士认为，在房地产领域，定向可转债此前主要承担项目融资功能，未来随着行业并购需求上升，其在房地产行业中的应用场景有望进一步丰富。业内人士表示，今年已披露预案的定向可转债已达12只，远高于去年同期，具备发行扩容的基础。（上证报）

headlines.title: 特斯拉降价后有门店爆单，多个汽车品牌开启促销
headlines.summary: 特斯拉降价冲上热搜后，多家门店爆单了。“昨天（9月7日）早上政策一出来，订单消息就没断过。”9月8日，某特斯拉体验中心销售顾问告诉记者，Model Y长续航版是消费者最关注的车型，截至9月7日下午，其所在的门店已锁定20多个订单。9月7日，特斯拉中国宣布，即日起至9月30日（含）前下单并提车，Model 3全系现车现金激励5000元，Model Y全系现车现金激励1万元。这并非孤立事件。据记者不完全统计，截至目前已有超过十家车企在9月集中释放购车权益，覆盖新势力、自主、合资与豪华品牌。（每经网）

headlines.title_en: Tesla stores see order surge after price cuts, multiple car brands launch promotions
headlines.summary_en: After Tesla's price cuts trended on social media, many stores saw a surge in orders. "As soon as the policy came out yesterday morning (September 7), the order messages never stopped." On September 8, a sales consultant at a Tesla experience center told reporters that the Model Y Long Range version is the model consumers care about most, and as of the afternoon of September 7, the store had locked in more than 20 orders. On September 7, Tesla China announced that for orders placed and vehicles delivered from that day through September 30 (inclusive), the entire Model 3 lineup in stock would receive a 5,000 yuan cash incentive, and the entire Model Y lineup in stock would receive a 10,000 yuan cash incentive. This is not an isolated event. According to reporters' incomplete statistics, more than ten automakers have concentrated their release of car-purchase benefits in September so far, covering new forces, independent, joint-venture and luxury brands. (National Business Daily)

headlines.title: 11月起新规实施 这七类服务费用由付款企业代扣代缴增值税
headlines.summary: 财政部、税务总局近期发布《境内单位代扣代缴自然人增值税管理办法》，从今年11月1日起施行。《办法》明确，今后企业或机构向个人支付研发、软件、设计、咨询、影视制作、文化、教育这七类服务费用时，要代扣代缴这笔业务对应的增值税。

headlines.title_en: New rules take effect from November: VAT on these seven types of service fees to be withheld and remitted by paying enterprises
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration recently issued the "Measures for the Administration of Withholding and Remitting VAT on Natural Persons by Domestic Entities," effective from November 1 this year. The Measures clarify that from now on, when enterprises or institutions pay individuals for seven categories of services—R&D, software, design, consulting, film and television production, culture, and education—they must withhold and remit the VAT corresponding to that business.

headlines.title: 第二十七届中国国际光电博览会在深圳开幕，AI和国产化双轮驱动，光通信全产业链持续高景气
headlines.summary: 从光纤到光模块，从光芯片到电芯片，每一个相关上市公司的展台都被围得水泄不通。9月9日，第二十七届中国国际光电博览会（CIOE中国光博会）在深圳国际会展中心开幕。多位业内人士表示：在全球AI（人工智能）算力基础设施持续扩张的背景下，光通信产业有望以更高的增速成长；共封装光学（CPO）、近封装光学（NPO）、全光交换机（OCS）等技术正在以超预期速度迭代，并带动上游光纤光缆、PCB（印制电路板）、片式陶瓷电容器（MLCC）等持续高景气。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: The 27th China International Optoelectronic Exposition opens in Shenzhen, driven by both AI and domestic substitution, the entire optical communications industry chain continues to boom
headlines.summary_en: From optical fiber to optical modules, from optical chips to electrical chips, every related listed company's booth was packed. On September 9, the 27th China International Optoelectronic Exposition (CIOE) opened at the Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center. Multiple industry insiders said: against the backdrop of continuous global expansion of AI (artificial intelligence) computing infrastructure, the optical communications industry is expected to grow at a higher rate; technologies such as co-packaged optics (CPO), near-packaged optics (NPO) and optical circuit switching (OCS) are iterating at a faster-than-expected pace, driving continued high prosperity in upstream optical fiber and cable, PCB (printed circuit boards), multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC) and more. headlines.title: 中金：后续通胀走势仍有赖于政策发力推动内需改善
headlines.summary: 中金公司研报表示，8月CPI环比上涨0.4%，同比由0.5%回升至0.8%，能源价格反弹是主要推动因素。PPI环比由下降0.7%转为上涨0.4%，同比由3.5%回升至3.8%，主要受原油、煤炭及有色金属价格上涨所带动。但在终端需求偏弱下，上游涨价向生活资料和终端消费品的传导相对有限，价格修复仍呈现明显的结构性特征。近期中东地缘局势反复，国际油价再度走高，我们认为，短期输入性通胀仍有粘性，但后续通胀走势仍有赖于政策发力推动内需改善。

headlines.title_en: CICC: Future inflation trend still depends on policy efforts to boost domestic demand improvement
headlines.summary_en: CICC research report says August CPI rose 0.4% month-on-month, with the year-on-year rate rebounding from 0.5% to 0.8%, mainly driven by the rebound in energy prices. PPI turned from a 0.7% month-on-month decline to a 0.4% increase, with the year-on-year rate rebounding from 3.5% to 3.8%, mainly driven by rises in crude oil, coal and nonferrous metal prices. However, given weak end demand, the transmission of upstream price increases to consumer goods and terminal consumer products is relatively limited, and price repair still shows clear structural characteristics. With recent repeated Middle East geopolitical tensions and international oil prices rising again, we believe short-term imported inflation remains sticky, but the subsequent inflation trend still depends on policy efforts to drive improvement in domestic demand.
